tldr: For the fixed-roster own-treatment effect with the mate untreated, an explicit graph-free sparse experiment attains worst-case squared risk at most \(12n^{-2/3}\), while every full-record procedure has risk at least \(\max\{1/n,n^{-2/3}/6400\}\). The supplied-matching risk lies in \([1/n,8/n]\), and the hidden-to-supplied ratio lies between \(\max\{1,n^{1/3}/51200\}\) and \(12n^{1/3}\). The consolidated theorem also displays exact equality, at every supplied matching, of the bounded-fiber, zero-irrelevant ANI, unrestricted-irrelevant infinite-moment ANI, and singleton-seed ANI minimax values. Their response classes remain distinct, and zeroing irrelevant cells requires the supplied matching. The converse permits all outcome-blind assignment laws and all measurable estimators retaining labels, the treated count, and auxiliary seeds. This is a prospective precision benchmark for direct-effect isolation motivating CauseIS \cite{FatemiZheleva2023CauseIS}.
gap: Known-network minimax theory conditions on observed links \cite{KandirosHarshawSavje2026Minimax}. Unknown-interference consistency theory estimates an assignment-marginal effect \cite{SavjeAronowHudgens2021UnknownInterference}. Neither evaluates the all-design precision of the untreated-mate endpoint with hidden perfect-matching membership.
fill: Open-ended Question 1 asks for an explicit finite-sample matched order, an observable attaining procedure, and an unrestricted converse.
